cards.ex: The design team is finally on the same wavelength about the new app's features.
cards.exUz: Dizayn jamoasi nihoyat yangi ilovaning funksiyalari haqida bir xil fikrda.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya yoki innovatsiyalar haqida bir xil fikrda bo'lish, tushunish.

cards.ex: They're really pushing the envelope with this new virtual reality technology.
cards.exUz: Ular ushbu yangi virtual reallik texnologiyasi bilan haqiqatan ham imkoniyatlarni oshirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Chegaralarni buzish, yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish, texnologiyada yangilik yaratish.

cards.ex: Investing in that company is bleeding edge; it could be huge, or it could fail.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritish juda xavfli; u katta bo'lishi mumkin yoki muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hali barqaror bo'lmagan eng yangi texnologiya, xavfli lekin qiziqarli.

cards.ex: The internet was a truly disruptive technology, changing almost everything.
cards.exUz: Internet haqiqatan ham bozorni buzuvchi texnologiya bo'lib, deyarli hamma narsani o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Bozorni tubdan o'zgartiradigan yangi texnologiya.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes with this new software, but it's worth it.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi dastur bilan ishlashni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak, lekin bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiyani yoki jarayonni qanday ishlatishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: The algorithm is a black box; we know what goes in and what comes out, but not how it works.
cards.exUz: Algoritm qora quti; biz nima kirishini va nima chiqishini bilamiz, lekin qanday ishlashini emas.
cards.uzDef: Qanday ishlashi tushunilmaydigan murakkab tizim.

cards.ex: Everyone's excited about the next-gen gaming consoles coming out this year.
cards.exUz: Hamma bu yil chiqadigan keyingi avlod o'yin konsollari haqida hayajonda.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyaning keyingi avlodi, yangi va yaxshilangan.

cards.ex: I need to get up to speed on the latest AI developments before the conference.
cards.exUz: Konferensiyadan oldin sun'iy intellektning so'nggi rivojlanishlari bilan tezda tanishib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiya yoki ma'lumot bilan tezda tanishib, uni tushunish.

cards.ex: Developing a working fusion reactor is a long shot, but the payoff would be enormous.
cards.exUz: Ishlaydigan termoyadroviy reaktor yaratish omadsiz urinish, ammo buning foydasi juda katta bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoli kam bo'lgan, lekin qiziqarli texnologik loyiha.

cards.ex: Their research lab is equipped with state-of-the-art technology.
cards.exUz: Ularning tadqiqot laboratoriyasi eng zamonaviy texnologiya bilan jihozlangan.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi va eng ilg'or texnologiya.

cards.ex: We're using new software to streamline the process of data analysis.
cards.exUz: Biz ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish jarayonini soddalashtirish uchun yangi dasturiy ta'minotdan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya yordamida jarayonni tezroq va osonroq qilish.

cards.ex: 'Synergy' is such a buzzword in the tech industry these days.
cards.exUz: 'Sinergiya' hozirgi kunda texnologiya sohasida shunday moda so'z.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya sohasida ko'p ishlatiladigan, lekin ma'nosi noaniq bo'lgan so'z.

cards.ex: The company prides itself on being on the cutting edge of AI research.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sun'iy intellekt tadqiqotining eng ilg'or qismida bo'lishdan faxrlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi texnologiyalarni ishlab chiqish yoki ulardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: We need to scale up our server capacity to handle the increased traffic.
cards.exUz: Oshgan trafikni boshqarish uchun server quvvatimizni kengaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Texnologik tizim yoki ishlab chiqarishni kengaytirish.

cards.ex: We're designing the system to be future-proof so it can handle new technologies.
cards.exUz: Biz tizimni kelajakdagi o'zgarishlarga moslasha oladigan qilib loyihalashtirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya yoki tizimni kelajakdagi o'zgarishlarga tayyorlash.

cards.ex: They built a proof of concept to show investors that the technology works.
cards.exUz: Ular investorlarga texnologiya ishlayotganini ko'rsatish uchun kontseptsiyani isbotlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiya yoki g'oyaning mumkinligini ko'rsatadigan namuna.

cards.ex: Bridging the digital divide is crucial for ensuring everyone has access to education and opportunities.
cards.exUz: Raqamli tafovutni bartaraf etish har bir kishining ta'lim va imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyadan foydalanish imkoniyatidagi farq.

cards.ex: Many promising technologies have fallen by the wayside because they couldn't compete with the established players.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab umid beruvchi texnologiyalar yo'q bo'lib ketdi, chunki ular o'rnatilgan o'yinchilar bilan raqobatlasha olmadilar.
cards.uzDef: Eski texnologiyalarning o'rnini yangilariga bo'shatib berishi.

cards.ex: There's no point in re-inventing the wheel; let's just use the existing technology.
cards.exUz: Velosipedni qayta ixtiro qilishning hojati yo'q; keling, mavjud texnologiyadan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Avvaldan mavjud bo'lgan narsani qayta yaratish.

cards.ex: Our new software can easily plug into your existing system.
cards.exUz: Bizning yangi dasturiy ta'minotimiz sizning mavjud tizimingizga osongina ulanishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiya yoki tizimga ulanish.

cards.ex: The new project is still on the drawing board, but we're excited about its potential.
cards.exUz: Yangi loyiha hali rejalashtirish bosqichida, ammo biz uning potentsialidan xursandmiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiya yoki loyiha hali rejalashtirish bosqichida.

cards.ex: We're looking for volunteers to beta test our new app.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi ilovamizni beta sinovdan o'tkazish uchun ko'ngillilarni qidirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Dasturiy ta'minotni ommaviy foydalanishdan oldin sinovdan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: He's an early adopter of all the latest gadgets.
cards.exUz: U barcha so'nggi gadjetlarning erta qabul qiluvchisidir.
cards.uzDef: Yangi texnologiyalarni boshqalardan oldin qabul qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: The software works great out of the box, but you can also customize it.
cards.exUz: Dasturiy ta'minot tayyor holatda juda yaxshi ishlaydi, lekin siz uni sozlashingiz ham mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday o'zgartirishsiz ishlatishga tayyor.

cards.ex: The prototype failed, so we have to go back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Prototip muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz qayta rejalashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.term: go back to the drawing board
cards.uzDef: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugagandan keyin qayta boshlash.

cards.ex: Everyone's wondering what the next big thing in technology will be.
cards.exUz: Hamma texnologiyadagi keyingi katta narsa nima bo'lishini o'ylayapti.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda juda mashhur bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: There are some exciting new developments on the horizon in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanadigan energiya sohasida yaqinda paydo bo'lishi kutilayotgan qiziqarli yangi ishlanmalar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada paydo bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Investing in bleeding edge technology can be risky, but the rewards can be great.
cards.exUz: Eng yangi texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritish xavfli bo'lishi mumkin, ammo mukofotlar katta bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hali yaxshi sinovdan o'tmagan eng so'nggi texnologiya.

cards.ex: The internet has helped to level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Internet kichik biznes uchun sharoitlarni tenglashtirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya yordamida imkoniyatlarni tenglashtirish.

cards.ex: The company makes data-driven decisions to improve its marketing strategy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya marketing strategiyasini yaxshilash uchun ma'lumotlar tahlili asosida qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlar tahlili asosida qaror qabul qilish.
